title: handle_remind_applicant duplicates ~110 lines of handle_remind_applicants' scaffolding instead of sharing a transaction/send/respond core
evidence: Bulk (548-587): `pog.transaction(db, fn(tx) {` ... `let #(pog.Returned(_, stage1_rows), pog.Returned(_, stage2_rows)) = #(stage1, stage2)` ... `clear_rejected_stamps(tx, vacancy_uuid, list.map(stage1_rows, fn(r) { r.sender_email }), stage1_recipients, sql.clear_reminder_for_sender)` ... `clear_rejected_stamps(tx, vacancy_uuid, list.map(stage2_rows, fn(r) { r.sender_email }), stage2_recipients, sql.clear_followup_for_sender)` ... `Ok(#(stage1_recipients, stage2_recipients))`. Per-applicant (722-772): the SAME destructure, `valid_recipients`, BOTH `clear_rejected_stamps` calls, and `Ok(#(stage1_recipients, stage2_recipients))` — character-identical except `mark_reminder_for_sender`/`mark_followup_for_sender` carry an extra `email` arg. The spawn+response+error arms (589-640 vs 773-830) are likewise verbatim apart from the singular error string.
detail: Only the stamp functions differ; owner check, transaction body, spawn, response, and error arms are copy-pasted. A future change to atomicity or response shape must be hand-synced across both — silent drift risk on the load-bearing stamp+send contract.
recommended_fix: Extract a private `run_remind_transaction(db, vacancy_uuid, stamp: fn(tx, vu) -> Result(#(stage1_rows, stage2_rows), QueryError))` owning the destructure/validate/clear/commit, plus a shared spawn+respond tail; both handlers call it with their stamp closure.

title: Awaiting-refetch-on-remind block duplicated verbatim between the bulk and per-applicant response handlers
evidence: Bulk ApiReturnedReminder: `let #(awaiting_list, refetch) = case model.vacancy_detail { Success(detail) -> #(Loading, vacancy_api.fetch_awaiting(detail.id, fn(result) { ApiReturnedAwaiting(detail.id, result) })), _ -> #(model.awaiting_list, effect.none()) }`. Per-applicant ApiReturnedApplicantReminder: the identical `let #(awaiting_list, refetch) = case model.vacancy_detail { Success(detail) -> #(Loading, vacancy_api.fetch_awaiting(detail.id, fn(result) { ApiReturnedAwaiting(detail.id, result) })), _ -> #(model.awaiting_list, effect.none()) }`.
detail: The same refetch-or-keep block now repeats in two reminder handlers. AGENTS.md says extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places; a `refetch_awaiting(model) -> #(RemoteData(_), Effect(Msg))` helper would remove the copy.
recommended_fix: Add a private `refetch_awaiting(model)` helper returning `#(awaiting_list, Effect)` and call it from both reminder success handlers (and the expand path at 2787 if it fits).
